## Multilingual E5 Large Instruct API

Multilingual E5 Large Instruct is an embedding model by Microsoft, available on the Venice API as `text-embedding-multilingual-e5-large-instruct`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

### Multilingual E5 Large Instruct API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text-embedding-multilingual-e5-large-instruct` | Standard | Private | $0.0125 / 1M tok |

### Multilingual E5 Large Instruct specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Microsoft |
| Released | Apr 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Dimensions | 1,024 |
| Max input | 512 tokens |

### How to use the Multilingual E5 Large Instruct API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings` with `"model": "text-embedding-multilingual-e5-large-instruct"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "text-embedding-multilingual-e5-large-instruct",
    "input": "Private AI for everyone."
  }'
```
